description: Start an agent_run. Computes ttl_deadline from agent's default_ttl_seconds, materialises agent_chain from parent_run_id, emits agent.run.started.v1 (regulated retention) with chain as actor provenance.

errorCases.when: No Authorization: Bearer <jwt> header on a requireAuth route
Bearer token fails verifyJwt (bad signature, malformed, or exp in the past)

errorCases.message: Required: agent_id, persona_id, trace_id, actor_id, actor_kind
errorCases.when: The body is missing any one of agent_id, persona_id, trace_id, actor_id or actor_kind
startAgentRun throws an error whose message contains "not found" — e.g. the referenced agent_id has no agent_definition row
startAgentRun throws for any other reason (constraint violation, model snapshot resolution failure, database unreachable)
